topics.text: The homestay is located in a peaceful village with convenient access, close to scenic spots such as Moganshan and Yucun core area, and offers a quiet environment. It is just a short drive to Moganshan Town and near scenic spots.
Hosts and their family are enthusiastic and considerate, actively recommending travel routes and restaurants, and preparing air conditioners in advance and helping with luggage.
Facilities are complete, with entertainment facilities like mahjong tables, billiard tables and game machines, and there is a swimming pool. Some rooms have balconies.
Rooms are tidy and clean, and the overall environment is hygienic.
Breakfast is rich, with homemade side dishes and other delicious food

address: No. 32 Shijiaoling, Group 7, Gaofeng Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 全家十幾個人完全夠住，離景區也很近，晚上全家聚一起麻將打牌ktv街機，玩的開心，周圍環境很安靜，老闆熱情周到，帶了長者，老闆給推薦了遊玩路線推薦了餐廳，全家住的滿意吃的滿意
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: omg！第一次住民宿就有很好的體驗！因為我們在遊樂園玩到很晚 然後又去吃了晚飯 晚上九點多十點才去酒店入住！爺爺奶奶一直在等我們！好感動！還給我們提前開好了房間空調！環境衞生都沒話説 有種回家的感覺 而且晚上睡覺很安靜～第二天的早飯也很豐盛！炒的鹹菜真的超好吃！！！可惜沒吃到自己種的玉米（我最愛吃玉米了好可惜～
comments.author: Woaixiangcaii

comments.quote: 老闆一家人都很和善，很熱心，幫了很多忙 民宿在村裡很安靜，適合發呆喝茶 早餐也很豐盛，房間很乾凈舒適
